name: Stripe
description: Read the connected Stripe account's billing: open and unpaid invoices with the customer's email and the next retry date, recent charges, plus create customers and payment links.
intentHints: who has an unpaid invoice in stripe

credentialFields.label: Secret key
credentialFields.help: Developers → API keys in Stripe. Starts with sk_.
credentialFields.patternHelp: A secret key starts sk_live_ or sk_test_ (a restricted key starts rk_). A pk_ key is the publishable one and cannot read anything.

providedTools.description: List recent charges, newest first. Each carries `status` (succeeded, pending, failed), `failure_code`/`failure_message`, `amount`, and sometimes `billing_details.email`. Stripe cannot filter charges by status, so read the field; DO bound the window with `since` or a daily job re-reads the same history every morning.

since.description: Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Only charges created at or after it.

providedTools.description: List invoices by status — use status='open' for money billed and not yet paid. This is the tool for chasing a failed payment, because the invoice is what carries the answers a charge does not: `customer_email` (who to write to), `next_payment_attempt` (whether Stripe will retry it for you, so you do not chase someone whose card clears tomorrow), `attempt_count`, `amount_remaining`, `due_date`, and `hosted_invoice_url` — a Stripe-hosted page the customer can pay on, so no payment link has to be created.

status.description: One of draft, open, paid, uncollectible, void.

since.description: Unix timestamp in SECONDS. Only invoices created at or after it.
